task.title: To connect to Microsoft Dynamics from X-Author Designer
task.shortdesc: If you have previously connected to your environment, but need to connect to a different

step.cmd: In the X-Author Designer or X-Author for Excel ribbon menu, click Connect. If this is the first time you have connected to your environment, the Manage Connections window opens.
Under the Create a new connection section, in the first field, enter a name for your connection.

note.p: If you have previously connected to your environment, but need to connect to a different instance, refer to Switching Connections .

step.cmd: In the second field, enter the URL you use to log in to your environment.
Click Authorize. The Microsoft login window opens.
Enter your username and password in the provided fields and click Sign in.

result.p: The X-Author Designer ribbon is fully enabled. Now you can start designing an app or using existing apps.
